result.note: Tests the structure of Delhi's July 2026 shift from reactive to continuous winter pollution curbs; the story does not name the deciding body, so that is not asked.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, Delhi changed its approach to tackling winter air pollution. Consider the following statements about the new curbs:
items: They will run continuously from November to February, regardless of air quality levels.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct. On 3 July 2026, Delhi fixed curbs for the whole November to February period, including 50% work-from-home, whatever the air quality. This replaces the reactive model, which imposed restrictions only after pollution spiked and has failed for years.
questions.source: Delhi then locked in continuous winter pollution curbs running November to February regardless of air quality, including 50% work-from-home, replacing the reactive model that has failed for years.
